sections.heading: Can: poder
sections.body:
*Poder* + infinitive expresses ability, possibility and permission: *Puedo nadar* (I can swim), *¿Puedo entrar?* (May I come in?), *No puedo ir* (I can't go). Remember the stem change: *puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden*.

(For a learned skill, *saber* is also common: *Sé nadar*.)

sections.heading: Must: tener que and hay que
sections.body:
- *Tener que* + infinitive = to have to (a specific person): *Tengo que trabajar mañana.* (I have to work tomorrow.) *¿Tienes que estudiar?*
- *Hay que* + infinitive = one has to / it's necessary (general, nobody in particular): *Hay que llegar temprano.* (You have to arrive early.) *Hay que* never changes.
- *Deber* + infinitive = should / must (obligation, advice): *Debes descansar.* (You should rest.)

sections.heading: Inviting, accepting, declining
sections.body:
Invite with a question: *¿Quieres ir al cine?* (Do you want to go to the movies?) *¿Te gustaría cenar conmigo?* (Would you like to have dinner with me?) *¿Por qué no vamos a la playa?* (Why don't we go to the beach?)

Accept: *¡Sí, claro!* (Yes, of course!) *¡Qué buena idea!* (What a good idea!) *¡Me encantaría!* (I'd love to!) *Vale / Está bien / Dale* (OK — *dale* is very Latin American).

Decline politely, with a reason: *Lo siento, no puedo. Tengo que trabajar.* (Sorry, I can't. I have to work.) *Gracias, pero hoy no puedo. ¿Otro día?*

Note *conmigo* (with me) and *contigo* (with you).

sections.heading: Asking for permission
sections.body: *¿Puedo…?* (Can I…?) *¿Se puede fumar aquí?* (Is smoking allowed here?) Answers: *Sí, claro. / Por supuesto.* (Of course.) *No, lo siento, no se puede.* (No, sorry, it's not allowed.)

examples: Do you have to study today?
Do you want to go to the movies?
Would you like to have dinner with me?
Lo siento, no puedo. Tengo que trabajar.
Sorry, I can't. I have to work.
Gracias, pero hoy no puedo. ¿Otro día?
Thanks, but I can't today. Another day?
No, lo siento, no se puede.
¿Por qué no vamos a la playa?
Why don't we go to the beach?
Dale, nos vemos a las ocho.
We have to clean the house.
